SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.language = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.uuid) AS percentage
FROM cards AS T1
JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
WHERE T1.isStorySpotlight = 1
